tools.description: Record one ruling on a scoped question: what was chosen, by whom, about what. Refuses in plain words when a field is missing.

about.description: The entity the decision is about: host, repo, service, role, agent or person (IRI or local name).

by.description: Who ruled: a Person or agent entity (IRI or local name).

chose.description: What was chosen, in one sentence.

decidedIn.description: The board item or session the decision was made in (IRI or local name).

dry_run.description: Return the record without writing it.

over.description: An alternative that was not chosen; repeat for each.

rationale.description: Why, in one or two sentences.

supersede.description: Confirm replacing a ruling by someone else: that record's IRI.

topic.description: The registered memory topic the decision answers (cy topic add registers one).

verbatim.description: The ruling in the decider's own words.

tools.name: record_decision

tools.description: Current decisions, optionally about one entity and topic.

about.description: The entity the decision is about: host, repo, service, role, agent or person (IRI or local name). Optional filter.

topic.description: The registered memory topic the decision answers (cy topic add registers one). Optional filter.

tools.name: recall_decision

tools.description: Every version of one decision key, newest first, superseded ones included.

key.description: The natural key: an IRI or the key path after mem/decision/ (for example about/topic).

tools.name: recall_decision_history

tools.description: Record a standing rule: one imperative sentence, who issued it, who it binds. Refuses in plain words when a field is missing.

appliesTo.description: Who or what the rule binds: an agent, CrewRole or repo, or 'crew' for everyone.

dry_run.description: Return the record without writing it.

issuedBy.description: Who issued the rule: a Person or agent entity (IRI or local name).

issuedOn.description: The date the rule was given, YYYY-MM-DD.

rule.description: The rule, as one imperative sentence.

supersede.description: Confirm replacing a ruling by someone else: that record's IRI.

topic.description: The registered memory topic the rule governs (cy topic add registers one).

verbatim.description: The rule in the issuer's own words.

why.description: Why the rule exists, in one sentence.

tools.name: record_directive

tools.description: Current directives binding one agent, role or repo, plus crew-wide ones.

appliesTo.description: Who or what the rule binds: an agent, CrewRole or repo, or 'crew' for everyone. Optional filter.

tools.name: recall_directive

tools.description: Write the agent's one current handoff; each write supersedes the last. Refuses in plain words when a field is missing.

agent.description: The agent the handoff is for (IRI or local name).

context.description: Context the next session needs; repeat, at most 3 lines.

dry_run.description: Return the record without writing it.

next.description: A next step pointing at a board item, PR or entity; repeat, 1 to 7.

supersede.description: Confirm replacing a ruling by someone else: that record's IRI.

waitingOn.description: What an item waits on; repeat, at most 7.

tools.name: record_handoff

tools.description: The agent's current handoff, if younger than its max age.

agent.description: The agent the handoff is for (IRI or local name). Optional filter.

tools.name: recall_handoff

tools.description: Record how a person wants something done, in one context. Refuses in plain words when a field is missing.

context.description: Where it applies: email, chat, code-review, document, artifact, form or travel.

dry_run.description: Return the record without writing it.

example.description: One short example of the preference applied.

notWhen.description: When the preference does not apply.

noticed.description: An agent noticed this preference; the person did not state it.

person.description: Whose preference it is: a Person entity (IRI or local name).

prefers.description: What the person prefers, in one sentence.

supersede.description: Confirm replacing a ruling by someone else: that record's IRI.

topic.description: The registered memory topic (cy topic add registers one).

verbatim.description: The preference in the person's own words.

tools.name: record_preference

tools.description: Current preferences of one person, optionally in one context.

context.description: Where it applies: email, chat, code-review, document, artifact, form or travel. Optional filter.

person.description: Whose preference it is: a Person entity (IRI or local name). Optional filter.

tools.name: recall_preference

tools.description: Record where a system lives and how to reach it. Key names only, never secrets. Refuses in plain words when a field is missing.

access.description: How to authenticate, in one sentence, without the secret.

dry_run.description: Return the record without writing it.

locator.description: Where it is: a URL, path, command or graph IRI. Never a secret.

probed.description: The locator was just probed and answered.

secretRef.description: The secret-store key name that holds the credential. A key name, never a value.

subject.description: The system the reference points into: host, service, repo or tool (IRI or local name).

supersede.description: Confirm replacing a ruling by someone else: that record's IRI.

topic.description: What the reference is for: a registered memory topic (cy topic add registers one).

tools.name: record_reference

tools.description: Current references, optionally into one system and for one topic.

subject.description: The system the reference points into: host, service, repo or tool (IRI or local name). Optional filter.

topic.description: What the reference is for: a registered memory topic (cy topic add registers one). Optional filter.

tools.name: recall_reference
